question: Ramanand spends 48% of his income on food, 25% on house rent, 12% on conveyance and 60% of the remaining on children's education. Find the percentage of his income left with him.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the total income of Ramanand be 100%.

Total direct expenses on food, rent, and conveyance = 48% + 25% + 12% = 85%.

Remaining income after these expenses = 100% − 85% = 15%.

He spends 60% of the remaining income on education, so he is left with 40% of the remaining income.

Percentage of income left with him = 40% of 15% = (40 ÷ 100) × 15% = 6%.

**∴ The correct answer is 6%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expense on food = 48%

Expense on house rent = 25%

Expense on conveyance = 12%

Percentage of remaining income spent on education = 60%
